name: Common Crawl URL Index
note: Query URL captures in the Common Crawl web corpus; coverage is large but not a complete historical record and captures can be missing or truncated.

name: Bellingcat Auto Archiver
note: Automate preservation of public web, video, image and social-media links for research workflows; archived copies still need provenance and timestamps.

name: Browsertrix
note: High-fidelity browser-based web crawling for reproducible web archives; configure crawl scope carefully and respect access restrictions.

name: ReplayWeb.page
note: Replay WARC and WACZ web archives in the browser without treating the replay as proof of when or how the original was captured.

name: Have I Been Pwned
note: Check whether an email or authorized domain appears in known breach datasets; exposure is a lead, not proof of current compromise or identity ownership.

name: PhoneInfoga
note: Structure public phone-number research and search pivots; use only lawful public or authorized identifiers and avoid inferring identity from numbering metadata alone.

name: GHunt
note: Research public Google-account and Google-object clues; some modules require authenticated Google context, so minimize account exposure and verify every attribution independently.

name: Tesseract OCR
note: Extract text from images and scanned documents locally; OCR output can contain recognition errors and should be checked against the source image.

name: MediaInfo
note: Inspect technical stream and tag metadata in audio/video files; metadata may be missing, rewritten or misleading and is not an authenticity verdict.

name: Sherloq
note: Digital image-forensics toolkit for examining compression, noise and other signals; anomalies are investigative cues, not proof that an image was manipulated.

name: Overpass Turbo
note: Query OpenStreetMap features with the Overpass API for geospatial hypothesis testing; OSM completeness and freshness vary by place and feature.

name: kepler.gl
note: Explore and visualize large geospatial datasets; visual patterns need source-quality checks and should not be treated as causal evidence.

name: OpenAerialMap
note: Discover openly licensed aerial and UAV imagery where available; coverage, capture dates and ground resolution vary substantially.

name: DNSViz
note: Visualize DNS resolution and DNSSEC authentication chains to understand configuration and delegation problems; it does not establish ownership or intent.

name: IntelOwl
note: Orchestrate IOC and file enrichment across many analyzers; third-party analyzers may receive submitted indicators or samples, so review data-handling before use.

name: YETI
note: Organize observables, entities and threat-intelligence enrichment in a self-hosted platform; source confidence and sharing rules still require analyst governance.

name: CIRCL hashlookup
note: Check file hashes against known-file datasets through a public API; a match can identify known content but a miss does not imply a file is malicious or novel.

name: USAspending.gov
note: Official US federal contracts, grants, loans and award-recipient data; interpret award dates, subawards and reporting limitations before drawing conclusions.

name: CourtListener / RECAP
note: Search US court opinions, federal dockets and RECAP filings; court records require jurisdiction, procedural posture and document-status context.

name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily
note: Official EU procurement notices and searchable tender data; procurement notices describe procedures and awards but may not capture every later contract change.

name: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer
note: Search US nonprofit Form 990 filings, financial summaries and full-text records; filing periods and processing delays matter when comparing organizations.

name: Global Fishing Watch Map
note: Explore vessel activity and maritime datasets derived from sources such as AIS; coverage gaps, spoofing and transmission behavior can affect conclusions.

name: OpenRailwayMap
note: OpenStreetMap-based railway infrastructure map useful for geolocation and transport context; map completeness varies by region.

name: Datasette
note: Explore, query and publish structured local datasets with SQLite-backed tooling; verify import transformations and avoid exposing sensitive research data.

name: Timesketch
note: Collaborative forensic timeline analysis for correlating timestamped events; timelines inherit clock, timezone, parser and source-data limitations.

name: GraphSense
note: Open cryptoasset analytics for addresses, transactions and graph paths across supported ledgers; clustering and attribution labels are hypotheses that need corroboration.

name: OpenAlex
note: Search scholarly works, authors, institutions, sources and concepts in an open research index; identity resolution and affiliation history still need verification.

name: Crossref Metadata Search
note: Search publisher-deposited metadata for articles, books, datasets and other research objects; metadata completeness depends on member deposits.

name: ORCID Search
note: Resolve public researcher identifiers and self-managed profile records; an ORCID profile can be incomplete and should not be treated as independently verified biography.
